title: Bone Monsters Banished
description: Hate skeletons? no more of them
body:
![SUPER EPIC TEXT "SUPER MONSTERS BANISHED" OWWW YEAHHH!H!H!H!H!H!!!!!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a0ea6bafd435fd464d08db476e47c61023c96427.png)

# NOTICE!
This datapack doesn't actually delete skeletons, yeah. It just teleports them to the coordinates **0 0 0** soo you can make skeleton farms get bones, arrows, bows and even armor! Just be aware of this warning, have fun!

![Map "SKELETONS TELEPORT TO 0, 0, 0 IN YOUR WORLD"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/43042992032f4696e1a1c0bdd092c7010e5d0253.png)
